name: phonon
description: Phonon is the multimedia API for KDE. It replaces the old aRts package. Phonon needs the VLC backend.

user:
LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$QT6PREFIX/lib cmake -B build -D CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=$KF6_PREFIX \
      -D CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH=$QT6PREFIX        \
      -D CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release            \
      -D PHONON_BUILD_QT5=OFF                \
      -W no-dev .
